player_prompt.intro:
U na le Player {player_id} Nim.
Lengo la hao ke u tsere objeke e tsotellang pele.
Ka mengwaha yohle, khaotse tšimong e le nngwe feela, mme u tlose objeke e le nngwe kapa e kgolo ho yona.
Sebetsa ka tshehetso '[pile quantity]', moo tšimong e leng indekse ya tšimong mme kgetho ke nomoro ya objeke u tlosang.
Ejemple, '[0 3]' e tlosa objeke 3 ho tšimong 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ha ho sebopeho se nepahetseng sa motsamao. Sebelisa '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Hatla ha halalelang. Kolone {col} e fetotswe.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Index ea palo {pile_index} e tsoa sebakeng.
invalid_move.non_positive: O tlameha ho tlosa bonyane ntho e le 'ngoe.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Ha khonehe ho tlosa {quantity} ho tšimong {pile_index} (ho sale {pile_count} feela).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Sebapali {player_id} se nkile ntho ea ho qetela ((s)!
